topic: Dragon's Loguetown storm wind is widely credited to him, but the wiki never confirms he caused it
title: Nobody Has Proven Dragon Made That Storm
description: Everyone blames Monkey D. Dragon for the wind that saved Luffy at Loguetown. The wiki says it's unconfirmed, and his Devil Fruit is still a mystery. Do you think it was on purpose?
comment: Did Dragon's wind save Luffy on purpose, or was it a lucky accident? Pick one.

lines.text: Everyone says Dragon made that storm at Loguetown.

shot.fallback: stormy coastal town, mysterious man in a long coat, anime style

lines.text: Smoker had Luffy pinned and cuffed, one step from a clean arrest.

shot.fallback: marine captain in a town square holding a young pirate down, anime style

lines.text: Chapter 100 says he would have succeeded without Dragon's interference.

shot.fallback: marine captain with white smoke around his arm, startled expression, anime style

lines.text: Then a massive gust blows the Marines back, and Luffy is free.

shot.search: Dragon wind blows Marines back Loguetown
shot.fallback: powerful gust of wind scattering marines across a town square, anime style

lines.text: But look at Dragon's wind in Goa too. Gusts and a lightning strike showed up nearby.

shot.fallback: revolutionary standing in a storm with lightning behind him, anime style

lines.text: The wiki's verdict is blunt: it's unconfirmed whether Dragon caused any of it.

shot.fallback: mysterious revolutionary silhouette against a dark sky, question mark in the clouds, anime style

lines.text: His Devil Fruit is still unknown, so nobody can tie the wind to him.

shot.search: Monkey D. Dragon Devil Fruit unknown
shot.fallback: hooded revolutionary with a swirling wind aura, anime style

lines.text: Here's my read: that storm is fan theory until someone proves it.

shot.search: Monkey D. Dragon storm fan theory
shot.fallback: fan theory board with a storm drawn over a town, anime style

lines.text: Fans say the timing is too perfect to be chance. Fair point.

shot.fallback: clock tower over a town during a storm, anime style

lines.text: But timing is not proof, and canon has never confirmed it.

shot.fallback: open manga page with a storm panel, anime style

lines.text: So who made the wind? Canon still says nobody knows.

shot.fallback: shadowy figure in a storm over a harbor, anime style

lines.text: Which raises the real question: why was Dragon in Loguetown at all?

shot.fallback: wanted poster of a young pirate on a town wall, anime style

lines.text: Which is why everyone still says Dragon's wind, even though nobody can prove it.

shot.fallback: revolutionary standing calm while a storm swirls around him, anime style
